llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The local canon parsing and mint-hash output are coherent with the documented LYGO identity/hash behavior and are limited to bundled files, so this does not support a Review verdict.
[SQP-2] expected: The ledger-writing concern applies to a separate verifier workflow referenced by the skill; it is disclosed as verifier behavior and is not automatic in this package.
llm.guidance: This is reasonable to install if you want the legacy LYRA persona or need to inspect its mint hash. Treat any linked verifier or mint/backfill workflow as a separate tool: review where it writes ledgers and confirm before using it to persist anchors or hashes.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed legacy persona helper with small local reference/hash scripts and no evidence of hidden execution, exfiltration, or automatic system changes.
